 Klarisse de Guzman's mother Esnobie passes away
 Source: klarissedguzman (IG) 
 By Aedrianne Acar 
 Published October 24, 2026 5:41 PM PHT 
 Scroll / Slideshow 
 Photo Inside Page
 Photos 
 Kapamilya singer Klarisse de Guzman shared devastating news to her Instagram followers that her mother Esnobie de Guzman has passed away.
 A few days ago, the Pinoy Big Brother housemate took to her Instagram broadcast channel and asked everyone to pray for her mama. She wrote then, "Namamanhid ako. I'm so scared. Pwede nyo po ba isama si Mama sa prayers nyo?"
 On Saturday afternoon, October 24, Ate Klang posted a photo of herself inside a hospital room wearing a laboratory gown.
 In the caption, she bid farewell to her dearest mother saying, “Mahal na mahal kita, Mama ko. Iyakap mo na lang ako kay Papa ah. Mahal na mahal ko kayo.”
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by KLARISSE (@klarissedguzman) 
 The post received hundreds of messages from celebrities expressing their heartfelt condolences, including those from Klarisse's fellow housemates Will Ashley, AZ Martinez, and River Joseph.
 Source: klarissedguzman (IG) 
 As of writing, Klarisse hasn't disclosed the reason of her mother's death or details of her wake.
